name: MCP2ANP Bridge Server
description: Enables MCP clients like Claude Desktop to interact with ANP (Agent Network Protocol) agents through three core tools: authentication setup, document fetching, and OpenRPC method invocation. Converts ANP's crawler-style interaction paradigm into MCP-compatible tools for seamless agent communication.
